newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iranian to face trial for killing nine women.
newsitem.headline: Iranian to face trial for killing nine women.

text.p: A man accused of killing nine women in Iran will go on trial in Tehran next week, Iranian state television reported on Monday.
It quoted a judge as saying the alleged killer was not Afghan, as first thought, but an Iranian.

"His real name is Gholam Reza Khushru-Kuran-Kordiyeh, that is, he was born in the village of Kuran-Kordiyeh, near Quchan, and lived in the village," the television, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation, quoted the judge as saying.
"By assuming false identity he had tried to mislead the police by protecting other criminals involved in the case and by hiding various stolen goods," the judge added.
Iranian media reports earlier described the suspect as an Afghan taxi driver who had kidnapped, raped and killed women and burned their bodies so they would not be recognised.
